run.change_description:
refactor: resolve SonarQube findings

- Reduce cognitive complexity in runProviderBackups, displayStartupConfig,
  checkProvider, Run and checkProvidersDefined by extracting focused
  helpers; behaviour and log output unchanged.
- Extract duplicated backup status titles into constants with a shared
  backupStatusTitle helper (notify.go).
- Remove TestPublicGitLabRepositoryBackup2 (identical duplicate of
  TestPublicGitLabRepositoryBackup) and simplify
  TestGiteaOrgsRepositoryBackup with assertion helpers.
- Dockerfile: merge consecutive RUN instructions, sort apk packages,
  quote the TAG variable in the download URL.

summary.intent: Behaviour-preserving refactor that resolves 13 SonarQube findings: split high-complexity backup/config functions into helpers, hoist the duplicated status titles into constants plus backupStatusTitle, drop an identical duplicate test, and tidy the Dockerfile (source: supplied PR 195 text and commit 136a485).
summary.issue_fit: Met — no originating issue existed, so alignment was judged against the PR text and commit message; every stated behaviour-preservation promise held under a line-by-line comparison of base and head, and the removed test is byte-identical to its twin.
summary.coverage: All four changed files reviewed against the complete merge-base diff. Reviewer ran `go build ./...`, `go vet ./internal/` and `go test ./internal/ -count=1` at the head offline: all pass (live provider tests skip without credentials). The Dockerfile could not be built (no Docker) and golangci-lint was not run; both were judged by reading. The two earlier Copilot comments (duplicate resetBackups call in the Gitea test, 'Organistations' log typo) both predate the change and are carried over unchanged, so they are recorded as observations, not findings. No verification batch was required.

observations.fact: The 'Organistations' log typo is carried verbatim into the new logProviderOrgs helper, which keeps the log output unchanged as the PR promises; it existed at the merge-base for GitHub, Gitea and Azure DevOps.
TestGiteaOrgsRepositoryBackup still calls resetBackups() inside each switch case and again after the switch, exactly as at the merge-base.
